title: Keep the classifier set in parity with Section curation
description: Backend plus Cyclotron engine. A new, renamed, disabled or removed NewsroomSection changes the site cyclotron's classifiers on the next sweep, with no manual step. The engine fixes the classifier set at open (definition fingerprint), so this needs Cyclotron support to add and retire a classifier in an existing store without losing learned rubrics; v1 fallback is a new store per Section-set fingerprint rebuilt from human labels, with the old store kept. Include a dry-run report of what a Section change would do.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Merged in PR 318 (with Cyclotron PR 51): the site cyclotron's classifiers follow the enabled Sections.
